summary: Iteration 2 testing of TaskMint major update: campaign approval flow, admin user mgmt, withdraw chips, sectioned home, link_url, telegram_contact, spin/scratch 50-100. Backend pytest 31/34 passing (91%); 3 failures are legacy DB migration gaps (existing seeded campaigns lack link_url field, existing user records lack total_withdrawn). Frontend manual+playwright validation on Expo web preview confirmed all key UX: Easy to Earn + High Paying Campaigns sections, banner/campaign testIDs, Profile QuickAccess (Telegram/Contact/Support/Privacy/Terms - no WhatsApp/Daily-Checkin/Withdraw rows), Refer hero ₹10+₹20 with 7-day/15-day streak, Withdraw chips ₹1/₹100/₹300/₹500 with inline error 'Please select an amount first' and gray disabled-style submit, Spin wheel showing 50-100 segments, all 5 admin stat tiles (Users/Active today/Pending WD/Paid WD/Pending Tasks) and 7 manage tiles (Users/Campaign Tasks/Withdrawals/Withdraw Amounts/Banners/Campaigns/Channel Links), Admin Users with email search, Admin Campaign Tasks with pending/approved/rejected/all tabs and Approve/Reject buttons, Admin Withdraw Amounts editor.

minor.issue: Legacy/seeded campaigns inserted before iteration 2 do not have link_url field. New admin-created campaigns include it. Existing 5 seed campaigns (PhonePe/Groww/Dream11/Cred/MX Player) will return without link_url, so frontend campaign tap cannot open external link for them. Suggest: backfill on startup OR change seed_initial_data to add link_url:''.

Existing user records (e.g. admin 93altaff@gmail.com seeded in iteration 1) do not have total_withdrawn field stored. Pydantic default 0 is not auto-applied to old Mongo docs returned by find_one with projection. Suggest: db migration to $set total_withdrawn:0 where missing, or normalize response in get_current_user/admin_get_user.

Legacy app_links singleton seeded before iteration 2 lacks telegram_contact key. Admin PUT works, but a fresh-install seed should include telegram_contact:''. Currently a stale seed will return links without the key (frontend tolerates with optional chaining, but worth backfilling).

ui_bugs.issue: Spec asks for testIDs spin-claim-btn / scratch-claim-btn AFTER spin/scratch completes. Could not verify presence post-action (animation flow). Pre-spin testIDs are spin-btn / scratch-btn. Main agent should confirm claim button uses these exact testIDs and renders only after first spin/scratch.

Submit button uses testID 'submit-withdraw-btn'; spec mentioned 'withdraw-submit'. Functionally correct (gray when invalid, shows inline 'Please select an amount first'). Doc/testID naming mismatch only.

Tapping a campaign-{id} on Expo web did not surface a Yes/Cancel confirm dialog. RN Alert.alert sometimes no-ops on web. On real mobile this works, but for web QA visibility consider a portable Modal/ConfirmDialog. Dialog event listener captured nothing.

integration_issues.issue: Backend returns link_url='' for legacy seeded campaigns, so even after pending insert there is no URL to open. Combined with backend minor #1, the campaign-tap end-to-end visibly does nothing for the 5 default campaigns until admin assigns a link.

issues: Persistent RN-web deprecation warnings: textShadow*/shadow*/props.pointerEvents. Cosmetic, no functional impact.

action_items: Backend migration: backfill link_url:'' on existing campaigns and total_withdrawn:0 on existing users. Easiest is on startup_event: db.campaigns.update_many({'link_url':{'$exists':false}}, {'$set':{'link_url':''}}); db.users.update_many({'total_withdrawn':{'$exists':false}}, {'$set':{'total_withdrawn':0}}); db.app_links.update_one({'_id':'singleton','telegram_contact':{'$exists':false}}, {'$set':{'telegram_contact':''}}).
Confirm spin-claim-btn / scratch-claim-btn testIDs are present after spin/scratch reveal and that they open RewardedAdModal (testID 'rewarded-ad').
Replace Alert.alert in campaign tap flow with a portable Modal so the confirm prompt also works on Expo web for QA/automation.
Optional: align withdraw submit testID name with spec (rename submit-withdraw-btn → withdraw-submit) or update spec.
Optional: silence RN-web textShadow*/shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~700-line file; consider splitting into routers (admin_users, admin_campaigns_completions, withdraw_settings) as it grows.

POST /api/tasks/campaign/{id} returns 400 for any prior status (pending/approved/rejected) which is correct but error message could carry the prior status in a structured field instead of detail string.
POST /api/admin/users/{id}/adjust-points: when delta is negative, total_earned is not decremented (correct). Good.
Admin completion approve correctly uses add_points_and_log which also bumps total_earned and total_tasks - verified via /auth/me delta.
Withdraw success flow now increments total_withdrawn - verified via fresh user. Existing users still missing the field (see backend minor #2).
Public /campaign-completions correctly filtered by user_id; admin endpoint returns all - verified.

rca_of_issue: Legacy data migration: Pydantic models added new fields (link_url on Campaign/Banner, total_withdrawn on User, telegram_contact on AppLinks) but the seed_initial_data() function only inserts when collections are empty, and does not migrate existing documents. find_one/find_many with projection {'_id':0} returns the raw Mongo doc which simply lacks the new keys. Fix on startup with db.<col>.update_many({'<field>':{'$exists':false}}, {'$set':{'<field>': <default>}}).
